notes: Built 2026-10-02. WebFetch was egress-blocked for every domain tried (nvidia.com, amd.com, docs/resources.nvidia.com, lenovopress, wikipedia), so no page could be fetched directly. Each vendor figure was cross-checked against web-search excerpts of the vendor page given in source. Because none were fetched, every record is labeled modeled. Per-field labels mark values that are estimates even beyond that (server power derived from board power, GB300 rack power, AMD softwareEfficiency default). Dense TFLOPS = vendor sparse figure / 2 unless the vendor gives a dense figure. Platform per-GPU values = platform total / GPU count.

gpus.name: NVIDIA GB300 NVL72
gpus.label: modeled
gpus.notes: Per-GPU = rack/72: 20 TB HBM3e (277.8 GB, rounded) and 576 TB/s. Rack lists FP4 1,440|1,080 PF (sparse|dense), FP8 720 PF sparse, BF16 360 PF sparse; dense per GPU = FP4 1080/72, FP8 360/72, BF16 180/72. NVIDIA does not publish a single rack power figure; 135 kW is an estimate from third-party/OEM reports of ~132-140 kW typical, peaks up to ~155 kW. Values match the vendor page per web-search excerpts; the page itself could not be fetched (egress blocked), so the record is labeled modeled pending a direct fetch.
